sources.title: Julius J. Chiavaroli — RIT Directory
sources.author: Rochester Institute of Technology
sources.content: Julius Chiavaroli teaches architecture, building systems, site and studio courses, integrative studio, and building-envelope topics, with interests in sustainability, urbanism, and community engagement.

sources.title: Whole Building Design Guide — Design Objectives
sources.author: National Institute of Building Sciences
sources.content: Whole-building design integrates functional, accessible, sustainable, secure, aesthetic, and cost considerations rather than treating building systems as isolated decisions.
